from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
from pathlib import Path

TERMINAL_STATUSES = frozenset({"Deployed", "Dropped"})


PUBLIC_LIST_LIMIT = 5


_SAFE_ITEM_ID = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*")


PUBLIC_ITEM_KEYS = frozenset(
    {
        "id",
        "repo",
        "kind",
        "title",
        "status",
        "issue",
        "pr",
        "branch",
        "problem",
        "solution",
        "needs",
        "pages",
        "child",
        "slugs",
        "updated",
        "priority",
        "priority_src",
        "order",
        "your_call",
        "call_kind",
        "ask",
        "steps",
        "links",
        "issue_no",
        "pr_no",
        "taken",
        "proposals",
        "history",
        "blocked",
        "dropped",
        "agent",
        "review",
        "gates",
        "labels",
        "raw_title",
        "evidence",
        "cost",
    }
)


def _write_compact(data: dict, out: Path) -> None:
    """Atomically write a UTF-8 JSON artifact without payload-only whitespace."""
    out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = out.with_suffix(out.suffix + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")))
    tmp.replace(out)


def _compact_fields(row: dict, *, required: set[str] | frozenset[str] = frozenset()) -> dict:
    """Drop values for which Atrium applies the same default; retain meaningful zero values."""
    empty = (None, "", [], {})
    return {
        key: value
        for key, value in row.items()
        if key in required or (value not in empty and value is not False)
    }


def _ledger_for(item: dict, ledger: list[dict]) -> list[dict]:
    slugs = set(item.get("slugs") or [])
    return [row for row in ledger if row.get("slug") in slugs]


def _public_item(item: dict, ledger: list[dict]) -> dict:
    """Project one full card into the Atrium contract plus bounded list summaries."""
    row = {key: value for key, value in item.items() if key in PUBLIC_ITEM_KEYS}
    history = item.get("history") if isinstance(item.get("history"), list) else []
    children = item.get("children") if isinstance(item.get("children"), list) else []
    item_ledger = _ledger_for(item, ledger)
    row.update(
        {
            # A child's complete report and execution metadata live in the detail artifact. The
            # public list only needs stable identities; Atrium reads sessions from top-level rows.
            "children": [
                {"slug": child["slug"]}
                for child in children[-PUBLIC_LIST_LIMIT:]
                if isinstance(child, dict) and isinstance(child.get("slug"), str)
            ],
            "children_total": len(children),
            "history": history[-PUBLIC_LIST_LIMIT:],
            "history_total": len(history),
            "ledger": item_ledger[-PUBLIC_LIST_LIMIT:],
            "ledger_total": len(item_ledger),
        }
    )
    return _compact_fields(
        row,
        required={
            "id",
            "status",
            "children_total",
            "history_total",
            "ledger_total",
        },
    )


def _detail_item(item, ledger, *, board, snapshot_digest):
    return bind_detail({**item, "ledger": _ledger_for(item, ledger)}, board, snapshot_digest=snapshot_digest)


def publish(data: dict, out: Path | None=None) -> None:
    """Publish the live board, terminal archive and complete per-card detail artifacts."""
    out = out or C.OUT
    data = {**data, 'generated': publication_generated(read_json(out, {}).get('generated'))}
    archive_out = out.with_name('work-items-archive.json')
    detail_dir = out.parent / 'work-items-detail'
    items = [item for item in data.get('items', []) if isinstance(item, dict)]
    ledger = [row for row in data.get('ledger', []) if isinstance(row, dict)]
    live = [item for item in items if item.get('status') not in TERMINAL_STATUSES]
    terminal = [item for item in items if item.get('status') in TERMINAL_STATUSES]
    recent_slugs = {child.get('slug') for item in live for child in (item.get('children') or [])[-PUBLIC_LIST_LIMIT:] if isinstance(child, dict) and isinstance(child.get('slug'), str)}
    public_children = [_compact_fields(child, required={'slug'}) for child in data.get('children', []) if isinstance(child, dict) and (child.get('slug') in recent_slugs or child.get('running') is True)]
    public = {key: data[key] for key in ('generated', 'statuses', 'decisions', 'host') if key in data}
    public['items'] = [_public_item(item, ledger) for item in live]
    public['children'] = public_children
    terminal_slugs = {slug for item in terminal for slug in item.get('slugs', []) if isinstance(slug, str)}
    archive = dict(data)
    archive['items'] = terminal
    archive['children'] = [child for child in data.get('children', []) if isinstance(child, dict) and child.get('slug') in terminal_slugs]
    detail_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    snapshot_digest = board_digest(public)
    for item in items:
        item_id = item.get('id')
        if not isinstance(item_id, str) or not _SAFE_ITEM_ID.fullmatch(item_id):
            raise ValueError(f'unsafe work item id: {item_id!r}')
        _write_compact(_detail_item(item, ledger, board=public, snapshot_digest=snapshot_digest), detail_dir / f'{item_id}.json')
    _write_compact(archive, archive_out)
    _write_compact(quality_audit({**data, 'items': live}), out.with_name('work-items-quality.json'))
    _write_compact(public, out)
